figurative_meaning_en: The best gem or uncrowned supreme
example_sentences_in_bangla: সঙ্গীতে সে তার ক্ষেত্রের মুকুটহীন রাজা।
example_sentences_in_english: Pelé was the crownless king of football.
He is the uncrowned king in his field of music.
note: Often used to denote unparalleled excellence without formal title, as in references to figures like Pelé in sports.
